Looking for a career in PMO and project management?

We are looking for a structured and proactive PMO Project Manager to join our Unified Platform (UP) Program. In this role, you will become a key part of the Program Management Office (PMO) and support the successful delivery of a global business transformation and rollout program.

You will work across multiple initiatives and stakeholders, helping to ensure readiness, alignment, governance, reporting, and execution throughout the entire implementation lifecycle.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys combining project management, planning, stakeholder coordination, governance, and process improvement in an international environment.

Key Responsibilities

Program Tools & Digital Collaboration

You will be responsible for maintaining and continuously improving key program collaboration and management tools.

Responsibilities include:

• Owning and maintaining core UP collaboration platforms, including Jira, and Confluence.

• Acting as Jira administrator and supporting configuration, workflows, dashboards, reporting, and new project rollouts.

• Driving adoption of program tools and ensuring they support efficient collaboration and transparency across teams.

Pre-Implementation & Country Mobilization

You will play a central role in preparing countries for successful implementation and supporting rollout planning activities.

Responsibilities include:

• Coordinating country readiness activities, including Country Readiness Assessments (CRA), data preparation, master data validation, and implementation handovers.

• Supporting regional and global rollout sequencing and implementation planning.

• Facilitating alignment meetings with regional stakeholders and implementation teams.

• Driving readiness validation processes and ensuring prerequisites, dependencies, and readiness criteria are met before implementation.

Governance, Reporting & Delivery Support

You will work closely with System Owners to maintain visibility, alignment, and progress across initiatives and rollout projects.

Responsibilities include:

• Supporting status reporting, KPI tracking, progress monitoring, and executive reporting.

• Creating consolidated visibility across initiatives, projects, and system deliveries.

• Facilitating governance processes, coordinating decision-making forums, and tracking actions and dependencies.

• Supporting backlog management, prioritization activities, and cross-functional coordination.

• Driving communication, planning, training coordination, and change management activities where required.

• Providing operational and administrative support to ensure efficient day-to-day program execution.

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for a motivated and structured individual who is eager to build a career within project and program management.

You may be a recent graduate or have a few years of professional experience within project coordination, PMO, consulting, business transformation, logistics, supply chain, IT, or a related field.

We imagine that you:

• Hold a master's degree in Business, Economics, Supply Chain, Engineering, IT, Project Management, or a related discipline.

• Have 3 years of professional experience, though newly graduated candidates are also encouraged to apply.

• Are highly organized and enjoy creating structure, transparency, and follow-up in complex projects.

• Have strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Are proactive, detail-oriented, and comfortable taking ownership of tasks and driving them to completion.

• Communicate clearly and professionally in English, both verbally and in writing.

• Thrive in a collaborative environment and enjoy working with stakeholders from different functions and countries.

• Are curious, eager to learn, and motivated by being part of a large-scale transformation program.

• Have experience with Microsoft Office tools and are interested in working with platforms such as Jira, Confluence, SharePoint, and Power BI.

Nice to Have

• Experience with ERP, TMS, Finance, Logistics, or Supply Chain transformations.

• Experience supporting global rollout programs.

What We Offer

• A key role in one of the company's most important transformation programs.

• Exposure to senior stakeholders and international teams.

• A broad role combining project management, governance, planning, reporting, and change management.

• Excellent opportunities for professional growth and development.

• A collaborative and ambitious working environment where you can make a real impact.

About us

Scan Global Logistics is a Nordic-based full-service global logistics provider present on all continents. From businesses across all industries to life-saving humanitarian organizations, we go above and beyond to bring anything anywhere – whether by road, rail, ocean or air.

We are guided by our fundamental virtues of Respect, Entrepreneurship, Integrity, and Fun and strive to bring a human approach to everyone, everywhere.

We run on the energy of good people, and no system or formula can compensate for that. Therefore, we also do what we can to unlock every employee's personal and professional potential so we can grow and thrive together.

Interested?

If you are passionate about driving structure, alignment, and successful program delivery while supporting large-scale business transformations, we would love to hear from you.

Join us and help shape the future of our Unified Platform journey.

If you have more questions regarding the role, please feel free to give Mette Kudsk Tordgaard, PMO Specialist, a call at phone +45 2240 9282 or visit www.scangl.com.

Are you passionate about leading high-performing teams and delivering business-critical technology solutions? BEC Financial Technologies is looking for a Development Manager to join our Document Lifecycle Management team at our office in Roskilde.

Our team develops, maintains, and operates core document management and archiving platforms used by Danish banks. These solutions support essential banking processes and enable secure, compliant, and reliable document handling throughout the document lifecycle.

As Development Manager, you will lead a distributed team of specialists based in Denmark and Poland and manage strategic vendor relationships. Reporting to the Head of Document Lifecycle Management, you will drive delivery, ensure operational stability, and support the continued evolution of critical platforms that operate around the clock, every day of the year.

Working closely with business stakeholders, architects, vendors, and other technology teams, you will play a key role in shaping the future of document lifecycle management at BEC.

At BEC, we prefer to collaborate often in the office, while also offering the opportunity to work remotely on average up to 1 day per week.

Primary tasks and responsibilities:

• Be accountable for the team’s contribution to the domain roadmap and delivery against agreed objectives.

• Drive the implementation and continuous improvement of technical solutions that create value for our customers and BEC.

• Define and maintain the delivery strategy and team setup required to deliver the team backlog effectively.

• Lead the performance of people, processes, vendors, and technology, with clear roles, responsibilities, and processes across the value chain.

• Build a culture of cross-functional collaboration, knowledge sharing, accountability, and continuous improvement.

• Manage and govern third-party vendors, ensuring delivery quality, performance, and alignment with business objectives.

• Ensure that development complies with BEC’s architectural principles, engineering standards, and security requirements.

• Own the maintenance and operation of the systems and platforms within the team, including incident and problem management, service continuity, system lifecycle management, and technical debt.

• Ensure operational excellence through proactive management of audit and compliance requirements, patching, technical vulnerabilities, exceptions, and lifecycle risks.

• Ensure that solutions comply with relevant regulatory, information security, data protection, and audit requirements.

• Secure the budget, resources, approvals, competencies, and organizational support required for successful delivery.

• Build trusted relationships with key stakeholders, gather feedback, and translate business needs into clear priorities.

To succeed, you will have:

• A relevant higher education, preferably within IT, finance, business, or a related field, combined with several years of experience in a similar leadership role.

• Proven leadership experience managing cross-functional and multicultural teams, preferably in mission-critical IT environments.

• A strong ability to set direction, develop people, create engagement, and establish clear accountability.

• A curious, open, and positive mindset, with a strong focus on collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous learning.

• A solid end-to-end understanding of enterprise technology, from user-facing applications and integrations to platforms and underlying infrastructure.

• Experience driving implementation, organizational change, and measurable business value.

• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate across business, technology, vendor, and leadership communities.

• A customer-focused and service-minded approach, with a commitment to stable, secure, resilient, and well-maintained solutions.

• A passion for agile values and principles, combined with the pragmatism to adapt ways of working to the team and delivery context.

• Professional proficiency in English, both written and spoken. Danish language skills are an advantage.

• The ability to travel occasionally between Denmark and Poland.

Nice to have:

• Experience from banking, financial services, or another regulated industry.

• Experience with regulatory compliance, audit management, information security, data protection, or operational resilience.

• Experience managing strategic vendors and commercially governed technology deliveries.

• Knowledge of document management, archiving, retention, document distribution, or related lifecycle processes.

Be your best self with BEC's benefits!

We offer a diverse range of benefits for our employees. Here are just a few of them.

• Professional development budget

• Healthy, varied lunch and fruit in the canteen

• Active staff associations: yoga, cycling, go-karting, games, bowling etc.

• Pension scheme

• Health and dentist insurance

• Referral bonus

What does the recruitment process look like?

• Screening call: Let’s talk and see whether we are a good match.

• Meet your future manager and team: Get to know the people you will work closely with.

• Personality assesment: Help us learn more about how you work and approach challenges.

• Meet our Talent Partner and your future manager again: Receive feedback on your assessment results and discuss the role in more detail.

Questions?

If you have questions about the position, please contact Senior Talent Attraction Partner Anders Rud Skak-Arnstrup at rud@bec.dk.

BEC is in the process of being acquired by our largest customer and co-owner, Nykredit, which is Denmark's largest mortgage provider and third-largest bank. We will become part of a new and larger organization called Nykredit Financial Technologies. In the transition phase, we are recruiting for roles that we expect to be highly needed in our future organization.

Do you enjoy working with data, spotting inconsistencies and figuring out why things don't add up? Are you curious about energy trading and looking for a student job where you can put your analytical skills to work? Join our Regulatory Reporting team in Aalborg and get hands-on experience in a complex industry.

Your team

At Norlys Energy Trading (NET), our Regulatory Reporting team uses data to demonstrate that our trading activities comply with energy regulations. It's a complex field, with multiple market participants, extensive regulation, and an ever-changing trading business. We work to make sense of that complexity and ensure our reporting is accurate.

Your role

As our new Student Assistant, you'll help ensure the accuracy of our regulatory reporting. You'll work with transaction data, perform controls, and investigate discrepancies to help us meet our compliance obligations.

You'll also have the chance to improve existing processes and help develop new controls as our trading activities evolve. Along the way, you'll build an understanding of energy trading and the regulations behind it.

Your key responsibilities

You'll work with data quality, reporting controls, and process improvements. Your main tasks will include:

• Perform controls and reconcile transaction data to ensure accurate reporting.

• Investigate discrepancies, document findings, and help resolve issues.

• Understand the transactions and regulatory requirements behind the data.

• Help define new controls as NET enters new markets and trades new products.

• Identify opportunities to improve processes by asking questions and challenging existing ways of working.

You'll get to work with real trading data and see how your work supports our regulatory compliance. There's plenty to learn, and you don't need to know the energy industry beforehand. If you're curious, thorough, and enjoy figuring things out, you'll feel right at home in this role.

– Morten Møller Jakobsen, Manager, Regulatory Reporting

What we're looking for

We're looking for a student who enjoys getting into the details, works systematically and takes pride in getting things right.

We imagine that you:

• Are currently studying and looking for a part-time job alongside your studies.

• Have a strong eye for detail and can maintain structure and overview.

• Are comfortable working with computers and have good general IT skills.

• Are familiar with Excel.

• Maybe have experience reading XML data.

• Communicate confidently in English, both written and spoken.

• Are curious, willing to learn and not afraid to ask questions.

You don't need previous experience with energy trading or regulatory reporting. What matters is how you approach your work and your willingness to learn.

What we offer

You'll gain practical experience in energy trading and regulation while working alongside your studies. You'll have real responsibilities, room to learn, and the opportunity to contribute to how we work.

• Hands-on experience: Work with transaction data, regulatory compliance, and process improvements.

• Professional development: Build your knowledge of the energy sector at a pace that fits alongside your studies.

• A social workplace: Join a company with many other student assistants and opportunities to take part in social activities.

• A predictable schedule: Approximately 15 hours per week across two office days in Aalborg.

• Hourly paid employment: A temporary, part-time position intended to run alongside your studies.

The position is time-limited, and continued employment within the team after graduation is not expected.

Ready to join us?

If you enjoy working with data, have an eye for detail and are curious about energy trading, we'd like to hear from you.

jobs.description:
At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees.

Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so.

Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!

**The Role

**The Senior Director, Transformation Office Portfolio Lead is a key role within Genmab’s Transformation Office (TO). The Senior Director will be the central orchestrator for operational and strategic initiatives, including initiative intake, prioritization, governance, reporting, and portfolio performance management. You will ensure that Genmab's most strategic initiatives are aligned with organizational priorities and deliver measurable business value. The initial focus of the Transformation Office is on R&D and Tech Ops (approximately 2,000 FTE), with potential for future scope expansion across the enterprise (⁓3,000 FTE).

The Transformation Office Portfolio Lead partners closely with senior business leaders, initiative sponsors, project managers, finance business partners and functional teams to drive rigorous initiative portfolio management, accelerate execution, and provide transparency on progress, risks, dependencies, and value realization.

As a key driver of the Transformation Office, the Senior Director will lead initiative portfolio management processes, develop recommendations on initiative prioritization, sequencing, and TO resource allocation, and ensure decisions are translated into action to maximize organizational impact.

The Senior Director, Transformation Office Portfolio Lead will report directly to Head of the Transformation Office (currently the SVP, Global Head of PPM & R&D Operations). The position can be located in Plainsboro, NJ, Utrecht, NL or Copenhagen, DK.

**Responsibilities

**

• Own portfolio management for cross-functional transformation initiatives that support Genmab’s financial commitments and strategic objectives

• Support the Transformation Office’s goals and objectives, aligned with the company’s overarching strategy and 2030 Vision

• Lead initiative intake screening, categorization, and prioritization processes, ensuring consistent application of prioritization criteria and governance framework

• Support, challenges and monitors projects, initiatives, and analyses focused on company transformation and productivity gains to inform strategic capital allocation and resourcing decisions

• Collaborate closely with Finance on Genmab’s long-range financial plan and annual budget cycle

• Drive the organization’s ongoing mindset shift toward productivity and prioritization

• Drive execution of initiatives from initiation through closure, ensuring clear ownership, milestones, and follow-through

• Track, report, and communicate TO initiatives to major stakeholders at all governance levels, including progress, risks, dependencies, and value realization

• Define, establish, and continuously monitor Transformation Office portfolio KPIs and success measures, ensuring transparent reporting of initiative performance, value realization, and overall portfolio health

• Lead the coordination and preparation of TO meetings and serve as meeting moderator

• Report on industry trends and peer company developments, translate their impact on Genmab, and improve overall strategic decision-making quality

• Work cross-functionally with R&D, Tech Ops, Commercialization, Finance, Human Resources, DD&AI, and other teams to drive alignment and execution

**Qualifications

****Qualifications and Requirements

**

• A minimum of 15 years of relevant experience with a Bachelor's degree in life sciences, business administration, economics or finance required is required; advanced degree (Master's, PhD) preferred.

• Prior management consulting with direct biotech/pharma case experience advising clients on company transformations required

• Prior biotech/pharma operating experience in a Transformation Office capacity and/or program and project management with a Finance background also highly valued

**Requirements

**

• Passionate about life sciences and Genmab’s purpose and mission

• Demonstrated knowledge and expertise to drive company transformations and productivity initiatives

• Experience preparing executive-level materials and presenting recommendations to senior leadership and governance bodies

• Excellent communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills across the different levels within the organization

• Highly organized, attentive to detail, and results-driven, with a strong affinity for financial analysis, business performance metrics, and value realization

• Highly self-motivated, with the ability to take ownership, drive activities independently, and manage multiple priorities

• Demonstrated ability to influence stakeholders, drive alignment, and achieve outcomes across cross-functional teams without direct authority

• Structured problem-solving skills

The proposed gross annual/hourly base salary range for this position, in the primary location, based on a full time schedule is:

DKK962.880,00---1.444.320,00

The final salary offer will depend on several factors, including your skills, qualifications, and experience.

In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and long-term incentives.

**Benefits

**When you join Genmab, you become a part of a culture that supports your physical, financial, social, and emotional well-being. Our benefits include, but are not limited to:

• Pension

• Health insurance and wellness benefits

• Paid time off

• Employee support programs

Further details on eligibility for compensation and benefits based on the role will be provided during the recruitment process.

**About Genmab

**Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.

Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Genmab is committed to protecting your personal data and privacy. Please see our privacy policy for handling your data in connection with your application on our website Job Applicant Privacy Notice (genmab.com).

Training Professional – Tablets & Finished Product

**Your impact begins here

**As Training Professional in Tablets & Finished Product, you will make training work where it matters most: in daily production. You will be the first point of contact for training in your area, helping leaders, supporters and operators keep training compliant, clear and practical. Your work supports stable, compliant operations, so the treatments we make for people living with serious chronic diseases are produced to the standard people rely on.

**What You’ll Bring

**You understand how clear standards and disciplined follow-ups, keep daily operations reliable, and you like being close to the people who run them.

• A bachelor’s degree in human resources or relevant field.

• At least 3+ years of experience working with training or training systems, for example as a Training Supporter, Training Coordinator, Training Partner or in a similar role.

• Fluent English and Danish, so you can communicate effectively in both languages.

• The ability to create structure and overview, follow up consistently and turn operational needs into practical training actions.

**Useful, But Not Essential

**

• Experience from production or a GMP-regulated environment.

• Experience with ISOtrain, Training Tracker, Outlook and Planner.

• A proactive approach: you take initiative and drive activities through to completion.

• Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills, and comfort acting as a sparring partner who gives advice and raises concerns when appropriate.

• An education in learning science, psychology, human resources or similar.

**What You’ll Do

**You will work close to the line of business, keeping training effective, efficient and compliant while helping the area improve how training is planned, followed up and embedded.

• Act as the primary training contact for your assigned area and give practical sparring to leaders, supporters and operators.

• Be present in daily operations to understand business challenges, and support continuous improvement and problem solving where training is a cause or part of the countermeasure.

• Improve training structures and processes, share best practice and provide training input and documentation for audits and inspections.

• Create transparency on training status, priorities and risks through reporting and regular follow-up with local leadership.

• Support leaders and other roles in using the training systems, Training Tracker and planning tools correctly.

• Keep training compliant and the local training setup running smoothly, through process conformation and consistent follow-up.

**Who You’ll Work With

**You will join Team Training within Production & Business Support (PBS), supporting the Tablets & Finished Product (T&FP) organization at the Måløv site. You will report to Mille Herskind Maltesen and become part of a team of 11 colleagues who work with training and capability development across the area.

Your closest partners will be leaders, supporters, coordinators and operators in T&FP, as well as the wider training organization. In Global Manufacturing & Supply, colleagues work across the value chain to bring Novo products to the people who need them, and your role keeps training a dependable part of that work. The team is defining and implementing best practices for how training supports production, and you will help shape them.

For further information, please contact Mille Herskind Maltesen, Manager, Team Training: QHMH@novonordisk.com.

**What You Can Expect Here

**This is a full-time position based on site in Måløv, Denmark, as you will support production every day. You will be trusted to take ownership and make your voice heard, with clear expectations for your work. You will grow through continuous learning and career development, and through close collaboration with colleagues across training and operations.

**What We Offer

**At Novo, you will join a global healthcare company with a distinctive culture and a strong track record. We offer continuous learning, career development and benefits tailored to your life and career stage.

Salary: The annual base salary for this role ranges from DKK 570,200 to DKK 838,100, depending on the level of the position. Placement within the range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge and relevant experience.

Incentives and benefits: The compensation package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives, together with other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks.

Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

**Start now

**Your impact begins today. If you are ready to take ownership of production projects that help, bring treatments to more people, apply for the Project Manager role 10th November 2026.

Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

The Department of Biomedicine at Faculty of Health at Aarhus University invites applications for a position as Postdoc in the field of Immunology and Fibrosis as per 1 February 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter. The position is a fixed-term full-time position for 2 years.

The Department of Biomedicine prioritises diversity and a good work environment, as this is a prerequisite for groundbreaking research. In a diverse and international research environment, dedicated employees are looking to generate new knowledge within biomedical research areas such as infection and inflammation, membranes, neuroscience and personalised medicine. The Department of Biomedicine provides research-based teaching of the highest quality and is responsible for a large part of the medical degree programme. Academic staff contribute to the teaching. English is the preferred language in the laboratory, at meetings and at seminars. The department employs approx. 500 people from all over the world, and they make use of the department's modern laboratory-, core- and animal facilities. The Department of Biomedicine focuses on innovation, entrepreneurship and collaboration with business and industry, and numerous researchers from the department have established companies to develop new medicinal treatments founded in professional scientific basic research. You can read more about the department here and about the faculty here.

About the research project
The postdoctoral position is part of a translational research project investigating the interplay between immune cells and fibroblasts in the development and progression of skin fibrosis, with a particular focus on systemic sclerosis (scleroderma) and keloid scarring.

The project is based on the hypothesis that immune checkpoint receptor pathways play a central role in regulating interactions between T helper cells and fibroblasts, thereby contributing to the development and progression of skin fibrosis. By combining advanced cellular and molecular techniques with patient-derived samples, in vitro co-culture systems, 3D ex vivo skin models, and experimental animal models, we aim to identify novel mechanisms driving fibrosis and explore potential therapeutic strategies.

The successful candidate will contribute to several aspects of the project, with a particular emphasis on experimental laboratory work and the integration of molecular and cellular data.

The succesful candidate will join an active and collaborative research team, with one PhD student and two Master's students already involved in the project, offering opportunities for close scientific collaboration, supervision of students, and contributing to the development of a growing research environment focused on inflammation and fibrosis.

Your job responsibilities
As Postdoc in Immunology and Fibrosis your position is primarily research-based but may also involve teaching assignments. You will contribute to the development of the department through research of high international quality. In your daily work, you will work closely with colleagues on your project, where you will receive supervision and guidance.

Your main tasks will consist of:

• Independent research of high international quality, including publication. .
• Analyzing and integrating multi-omics datasets, including single-cell and spatial transcriptomics, to identify cellular interactions and signaling pathways associated with fibrosis.
• Performing advanced cellular and molecular analyses, including multicolor flow cytometry, immunofluorescence, and gene expression profiling.
• Establishing and optimizing primary cell cultures and in vitro co-culture systems to investigate interactions between T cells and fibroblasts.
• Developing and applying 3D ex vivo skin models using patient-derived biopsies to investigate fibrotic mechanisms and evaluate potential therapeutic interventions.
• Contributing to experimental studies using mouse models of skin fibrosis, including bleomycin-induced fibrosis and keloid models.
You will report to the Associate Professor Stinne Greisen.

Your competences 
You have academic qualifications at PhD level, within immunology, autoimmunity, molecular medicine, molecular biology, biomedical sciences, or a related field. We highly value experience within:

• Analysis and interpretation of high-dimensional datasets, particularly single-cell RNA sequencing, spatial transcriptomics, or other multi-omics approaches.
• Experimental immunology, particularly T-cell biology, immune regulation, or inflammatory signaling pathways.
• Advanced cell culture techniques, including primary human cell cultures, immune cell isolation, and functional co-culture assays.
• Cellular and molecular techniques, including multicolor flow cytometry, immunofluorescence microscopy, and gene and protein expression analyses.
• Development or application of advanced experimental models, including 3D cell cultures, organoids, or ex vivo tissue models.
• Working with animal/mouse models of inflammation or fibrosis
As a person, you have good interpersonal skills, are inclusive and team-oriented and able to contribute to a good work environment. We expect you to be fluent in oral and written English.

In order to be assessed as qualified for a Postdoc position, you must meet these academic criteria.

Shortlisting will be used.

Questions about the position
If you have any questions about the position, please contact Stinne Greisen tel.: (+45) 22451114.

Your place of work will be the Department of Biomedicine, Wilhelm Meyers Alle 4, DK-8000 Aarhus C, Denmark.

We expect to conduct interviews around week 50

Terms of employment 
• Appointment as a postdoc requires academic qualifications at PhD level.
• Further information on the appointment procedure can be found in the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities.
• The appointment is in accordance with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (Akademikerne).
• Remuneration is in accordance with the above, and the Salary agreement catalogue for staff at Health.
• The yearly base salary for a fulltime postdoc is between DKK 493.394,35 and DKK 585.322,48 depending on the years of working experience after achieved MSc degree. The base salary includes a position related supplement and pension (18.07 %). Additional supplement(s) for special qualifications can be negotiated. Authorisation supplemement(s) will be granted, if relevant for the position. Your local eligible trade union representative at Aarhus University negotiates your salary on your behalf.
• Researchers recruited from abroad are offered a special researcher tax scheme with a lower tax rate.
• Further information on qualification requirements and job description can be found in the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff

Application
Your application must include the following:

• Motivated application
• Curriculum Vitae
• Diploma
• Template for applicant - postdoc
• A list of publications
• A teaching portfolio. We refer to Guideline on the use of teaching portfolios
• A maximum of five of the publications of greatest relevance to the job may be submitted (optional)
• Research plan can be uploaded (optional)
• Coauthor statement(s) can be uploaded (optional)
• References/recommendations can be uploaded separately in the e-recruitment system (optional)
We refer to the faculty’s Guidelines for applicants.

Aarhus University’s ambition is to be an attractive and inspiring workplace for all and to foster a culture in which each individual has opportunities to thrive, achieve and develop. We view equality and diversity as assets, and we welcome all applicants.

International applicant?
Aarhus University offers a broad variety of services for international researchers and accompanying families, including assistance with relocation and career counselling to expat partners. Please find more information about the International Staff Office and the range of services here. Aarhus University also has a Junior Researcher Association and offers career development support. You can read more about these resources here.

The application must be submitted via Aarhus University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aarhus University's website.

Monthio is looking for a Head of Finance with a strong financial foundation and an interest in working closely with the business. You will have overall responsibility for the finance function and a central role in the company's development. Perhaps you already lead a finance function, or perhaps you are an experienced Senior Controller or Finance Business Partner ready to take the next step. Most importantly, you can combine a broad overview with a hands-on approach and thrive with esponsibility for both day-to-day operations and the further development of the finance function. Experience from a similar role is an advantage, but not a requirement.

Your role

You will have overall responsibility for financial management, reporting and the ongoing development of Monthio's finance function. You will join the management team, report to the COO and work closely with the CCO and the rest of the management team to provide a true and fair picture of the company's finances and a solid basis for decisions. You will attend board meetings, where you present financial results, expectations and key risks, and you will manage the dialogue with our lender and other external stakeholders.

As the only in-house member of the finance function, you will have a broad role that requires an eye for the whole business and the ability to turn insight into action. Day-to-day bookkeeping and payroll are handled by an external partner. You will manage the partnership, ensure quality and follow up on deliverables. At the same time, you will work hands-on with analyses, models, reporting and processes, and ensure that the finance function supports both daily operations and the company's growth.

Your responsibilities

Budgets, forecasts and liquidity

Drive the budget process and rolling forecasts, and further develop the financial model so that changes in hiring plans, other costs and expected revenue are continuously reflected and provide a basis for adjusting the company's priorities.

Monitor liquidity, cash burn and runway, and make the impact of changes in revenue, costs and investments visible.

Explain variances against budget and forecast, and turn analyses and scenarios into concrete recommendations to management.

Reporting and commercial partnering

Prepare monthly reporting for management and the board, as well as investor reporting, with clear conclusions on performance, expectations and risks.

Prepare board materials together with the COO and the Chairman, and present the key financial points at board meetings.

Consolidate the commercial forecast together with the CCO and ensure consistency between pipeline and forecast.

Accounting and financial control

Ensure a timely and accurate month-end close, including reconciliations, accruals and quality assurance of the accounts, in collaboration with the external partner.

Coordinate the annual report and audit, and ensure follow-up on VAT, tax and other financial filings together with external advisors.

Maintain internal controls and approval procedures, handle payments and ensure correct calculation of sales commissions.

Systems and automation

Drive improvements in finance systems and workflows based on e- conomic, Pleo, Fenerum and Corpay.

Reduce manual work and strengthen data quality through better integrations, automation and relevant use of AI.

Your profile

You master the financial craft, understand the business behind the numbers and take ownership of getting things done. You collaborate and communicate on an equal footing with internal and external stakeholders involved in construction projects. You bring professional credibility in your field and can work independently.

• An understanding of the structure and application of quality management systems.

• Experience with project- and process-related work.

• Experience with quality management activities in infrastructure and construction projects, including quality assurance (QA) and providing input to quality control (QC) activities.

• Experience carrying out quality activities, including audits and inspections of internal and external parties involved in projects.

• Experience using the Microsoft Office suite.

• The ability to communicate in Danish and English, both orally and in writing, at negotiation level.

**At COWI, we work together with our customers to shape a sustainable and liveable world. We do it by applying our knowledge and curiosity – and sometimes even our courage – to create the solutions the world needs today to enable a better tomorrow. We support our customers’ transition towards increased sustainability. The Novo Nordisk Foundation Quantum Computing Programme (NQCP) is expanding its talented and international team to add to its cutting-edge quantum programme in the heart of Copenhagen, Denmark. At the Niels Bohr Institute, University of Copenhagen, we are running an international quantum computing programme, funded by the Novo Nordisk Foundation, that drives research and innovations at multiple levels - from developing scalable quantum processor technologies to quantum algorithms and applications.  The long-term mission of the programme is to develop fault-tolerant quantum computing hardware and quantum algorithms that solve life-science-relevant chemical and biological problems.

  Start date is the 1st of February 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter. 

  The project 
 The position is centred on the development of integrated superconducting nanowire single-photon detectors (SNSPDs) embedded in controllable photonic circuits for the fully integrated processing of the emitted photons from silicon quantum emitters. The work will be performed as part of the Photonic Control and Readout team in NQCP, in close collaboration with the Theory & Simulation and the Materials engineering teams at NQCP and the Growth team at Quantum Foundry. These teams will support the efforts of the development and integration of SNSPDs in our photonic circuit.

  You will be collaborating closely with the other team members of the Photonic C&R team and – like the rest of the team - be generally involved in the projects related to the platform. A number of students will also be dedicated to the SNSPD projects. The nanofabrication is done at the DTU Nanolab – a 1,350 m² ISO 4–6 cleanroom with over 150 state-of-the-art tools, and one of the leading cleanrooms in Europe. Testing and integration of the SNSPDs will be done at the NQCP Photonics lab at the Niels Bohr Institute established in 2023. The lab contains a range of cryostats (mK to 4K) designed for optical fibre access, state-of-the-art electronics, commercial SNSPDs, etc.

  The position is also open as an assistant professor. Please apply to the call corresponding to the position relevant for you.

  Responsibilities:

   	
• Taking the leading role in developing and integrating SNSPDs into our photonic circuits and establishing the electrical control circuit. 	
• Structuring the efforts on multiple projects, integrating experimental results in our database, and providing feedback to collaborating teams. 	
• Contributing to the other projects within the Photonics team. The projects span single photon sources and optical components like switches, cavities, etc. 	
• Teaching and supervision of students. 	
• Procurement, maintenance, and operation of scientific equipment.    

  We are looking for the following qualifications: 

   	
• PhD with postdoc experience in experimental physics, engineering, nanotechnologies, or related. 	
• Experience with SNSPDs fabrication and characterisation, quantum photonics, electronics, and cryogenic systems. 	
• Experience with control software and data logging – preferably in python.   Good communication skills and a structured approach to work.
 
 Why Us? 
 Joining NQCP now, you will get involved in a well-established and ambitious programme, which offers excellent opportunities to build a career in advancing quantum computing. We want to make Denmark a world leader in quantum research, and we hope to attract people from all over the world.

Dual career families are the norm, and workplaces offer flexibility to support everyone in having both an exciting career and good family time. Danish cities are known for having excellent infrastructure, for example through widespread bike path networks. We can also offer a thriving food-scene, excellent museums, and beautiful natural scenery.

 Your application including all attachments must be in English and submitted electronically.

jobs.occupation: Product Marketing Manager - B2B Software for Manufacturers
jobs.description:
Highlights:

• Fast-growing B2B software platform with established global reach is looking for our first marketing hire.

• We have a broad, multi-product offering for a narrow industry, and we don't fit into a single existing "category box" as defined today -- giving you a meaty challenge to work with.

• We have large customers and touch a lot of users (as a platform for managing global supply-chains), so your work will be "heard around the world"

• We are a small, efficient, get-stuff-done team. Looking for someone who things that's the way to go.

About Supplios

Manufacturers live or die by their supply base. Sourcing the wrong supplier, onboarding one slowly, failing to qualify one properly or losing track of a non-conformance can stop a production line and cost millions. Yet most manufacturers still run these relationships across email chains, spreadsheets and shared drives.

Supplios is a supplier collaboration platform for manufacturers in automotive and industrial sectors. We cover the full supplier relationship: sourcing, onboarding, qualification, day-to-day collaboration, compliance and supplier quality — with a modern cloud based platform that is easy for manufacturers to implement and operate. It is built specifically for the way automotive and industrial manufacturers actually work.

We are headquartered in central Copenhagen and already serve customers globally in our vertical, including some of the most demanding names in automotive. We have grown to this point almost entirely on product strength, domain credibility and word of mouth. We have done very little marketing.

That is where you come in.

The role

This is our first marketing hire.

You will own positioning, messaging and sales enablement for a platform that already has real customers, real reference stories and real competitive wins — but no one whose job it is to articulate any of it. There is no existing playbook to inherit, no legacy brand guidelines to work around, and no committee to navigate. There is a large amount of low-hanging fruit and a clear runway to make a visible commercial impact within your first few months.

You will work directly and closely with our co-founder and CEO, who continues to run product. He knows the product and the domain deeply; what he needs is a strong product marketing partner to turn that into sharp positioning, messaging that lands with procurement, quality and operations buyers, and material that makes the sales conversation easier.

This is a hands-on, execution-focused role. You will be writing the copy, building the deck and updating the website — not briefing an agency to do it.

We work together from our office in central Copenhagen. This is primarily an in-office role: at this stage, and in this role in particular, the close working relationship with management & sales is much easier to build in person.

What you will do

• Own positioning and messaging for the Supplios platform and its individual modules, and make it consistent across every touchpoint

• Translate technical capability into buyer-relevant value for distinct personas — sourcing and procurement leads, supplier quality engineers, quality directors, supply chain and operations management

• Build the sales enablement layer: pitch decks, one-pagers, battlecards, demo narratives, proposal content and objection handling

• Run competitive and market intelligence, and keep the team honest about where we genuinely win and where we do not

• Plan and execute go-to-market for new modules and major releases, in step with the product roadmap

• Develop customer proof — case studies, reference stories and use cases — from an installed base that has plenty to say

• Rebuild our website messaging and product pages so they reflect what we actually do and who we do it for

• Feed structured market and customer insight back into product decisions

What we are looking for

Essential

• Proven product marketing experience in B2B or enterprise software, with responsibility for positioning, messaging and sales enablement

• A demonstrable track record of translating complex, technical products into clear commercial value propositions

• Excellent written English

• Comfort operating without a marketing team, an established playbook or a large budget — you scope the work, then do it

• The temperament for a small, senior, fast-moving company: high ownership, low ceremony

Nice to have

• Domain knowledge in automotive, industrial manufacturing or supply chain. Genuinely a plus, not a requirement. We can teach the domain to the right marketer; we cannot teach product marketing to a domain expert.

• Experience marketing to enterprise buyers with long, multi-stakeholder sales cycles

• Experience as an early marketing hire at a growing B2B software company

Language

• English is the only important language for this position — we work in English, and so do our customers. Danish language skills are not required.

Why this role is worth your time

• First marketing hire, not the fifth. You define how this company talks about itself.

• A product that already works. Real global customers in a demanding vertical, and reference stories waiting to be told.

• Work directly with the CEO/founders. No layers between you and the decisions.

• Visible impact. In a company that has barely marketed, good product marketing shows up in the pipeline quickly.

How to apply

Send your CV and a short note on why this role interests you to team@supplios.com. Work examples will help.

Apply by email

Send an email to team@supplios.com

Please include your CV / resume, and a brief note about why you're interested in the position.

Thanks!

jobs.occupation: PhD scholarship in Predictive Human Digital Twins for Human-Centred Systems Engineering – DTU Construct
jobs.description:
Are you interested in human-centred engineering at the intersection of biomechanics, artificial intelligence, and systems engineering, and want to build a strong methodological profile, this PhD position offers a unique opportunity – including the chance to help shape a new research group from the start.

At DTU Construct, you will develop methods that turn generic musculoskeletal models into personalised Human Digital Twins – based on sparse wearable sensor data instead of costly laboratory measurements or medical imaging – and assess how reliably they predict how a person moves and interacts with technical systems such as collaborative robots or assistive devices. The project is part of building up a new research group in Human-Centred Design within the Human-Centred Systems Engineering activities at DTU Construct. As part of the DTU PhD programme, you will follow PhD-level courses and contribute to teaching.

Responsibilities and qualifications
Your overall purpose will be to develop and validate methods for personalising biomechanical Human Digital Twins from sparse sensor data, combining physics-based and data-driven approaches and quantifying the gap between simulation and reality (sim2real).

Your primary tasks will be to:

• Develop methods for personalising musculoskeletal models from sparse multimodal sensor data.
• Combine physics-based and data-driven approaches for model calibration and prediction.
• Quantify and reduce the sim2real gap of Human Digital Twins.
• Plan and carry out experimental studies with human participants.
• Implement your methods in open, reusable software.
• Publish your results and collaborate with researchers at DTU and international partners.
We are looking for a motivated candidate with:

• An MSc in Biomedical or Mechanical Engineering, Robotics, Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Engineering Design, or a related field.
• Solid programming skills (e.g. Python, MATLAB, C++).
• A background in simulation, optimisation, machine learning, sensor processing, or parameter estimation.
• A strong interest in computational modelling of humans and human-technology systems.
• Good communication skills in English and the ability to work both independently and in a team.
• Experience with musculoskeletal modelling (e.g. OpenSim, AnyBody, SCONE), motion analysis, or wearable sensing is an advantage.
• We do not expect you to master all of these areas – a solid foundation and the motivation to grow into the field matter most.
You must have a two-year master's degree (120 ECTS points) or a similar degree with an academic level equivalent to a two-year master's degree.

Approval and Enrolment 
The scholarship for the PhD degree is subject to academic approval, and the candidate will be enrolled in one of the general degree programmes at DTU. For information about our enrolment requirements and the general planning of the PhD study programme, please see DTU's rules for the PhD education. 

Assessment
The assessment of the applicants will be made by Jörg Miehling.

We offer
DTU is a leading technical university globally recognized for the excellence of its research, education, innovation and scientific advice. We offer a rewarding and challenging job in an international environment. We strive for academic excellence in an environment characterized by collegial respect and academic freedom tempered by responsibility.

Salary and appointment terms
The appointment will be based on the collective agreement with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. Please see DTU’s salary structure for scientific staff: www.inside.dtu.dk/en/human-resources/during-employment/salary/salary-structures.

The period of employment is 3 years. Starting date is 1 March 2027 (or according to mutual agreement). The position is a full-time position.

You can read more about career paths at DTU here.

Further information
Further information may be obtained from Jörg Miehling, jormi@dtu.dk (please mention “PhD Position Inquiry” in your email subject).

You can read more about Department of Civil and Mechanical Engineering at www.construct.dtu.dk and the Section at www.construct.dtu.dk/sections/engineering-design-and-manufacturing-systems.

If you are applying from abroad, you may find useful information on working in Denmark and at DTU at DTU – Moving to Denmark. Furthermore, you have the option of joining our monthly free seminar “PhD relocation to Denmark and startup “Zoom” seminar” for all questions regarding the practical matters of moving to Denmark and working as a PhD at DTU. 

Application procedure 
Your complete online application must be submitted no later than 2 December 2026 (23:59 Danish time). Applications must be submitted as one PDF file containing all materials to be given consideration. To apply, please open the link "Apply now", fill out the online application form, and attach all your materials in English in one PDF file. The file must include:

• A letter motivating the application (cover letter)
• Curriculum vitae 
• Grade transcripts and BSc/MSc diploma (in English) including official description of grading scale
• A copy of your BSc thesis (in pdf)
• A copy of your MSc thesis (in pdf)
• A copy of your scientific articles (if any) published so far (in pdf)
You may apply prior to obtaining your master's degree but cannot begin before having received it. 

Applications received after the deadline will not be considered.

All interested candidates irrespective of age, gender, disability, race, religion or ethnic background are encouraged to apply. As DTU works with research in critical technology, which is subject to special rules for security and export control, open-source background checks may be conducted on qualified candidates for the position.

DTU Civil and Mechanical Engineering develops and utilises science and technical knowledge for the benefit of society and the sustainable development. We undertake research, education, innovation, and scientific advice of the highest quality within building design and processes, building construction and safety, building energy and technical services, solid mechanics, fluid mechanics, coastal and maritime engineering, materials technology, manufacturing engineering, engineering systems design, design for sustainability, and thermal energy.

The Section of Engineering Design and Manufacturing Systems (EDM) advances the design of intelligent, resilient, and sustainable products and manufacturing systems, integrating systems engineering, modular architectures, robust and bio-inspired design, and AI-enabled engineering.

DTU – For the benefit of society since 1829
DTU is one of Europe's leading elite technical universities. Through research and education at an international top level, we create solutions to the major societal challenges of our time and help secure Europe's global leadership in sustainable technological development. Since Hans Christian Ørsted founded DTU almost 200 years ago, our mission has remained the same: We develop and create value through the natural and technical sciences for the benefit of society. DTU has 13,800 students, 1,600 PhD students, and 6,500 employees. We work in an international environment and have an inclusive, stimulating, and informal work culture. DTU has campuses in all parts of Denmark and in Greenland and collaborates with the best universities around the world.
